// CASE dart_while_index expect=fire
Future<void> a(List<int> items) async {
  var i = 0;
  while (i < items.length) {
    await save(items[i]);
    i++;
  }
}
// CASE dart_do_while expect=fire
Future<void> b(List<int> items) async {
  var i = 0;
  do {
    await save(items[i]);
  } while (++i < items.length);
}
// CASE dart_braceless_for expect=fire
Future<void> c(List<int> items) async {
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) await save(items[i]);
}
// CASE dart_map_entries expect=fire
Future<void> d(Map<String, int> map) async {
  for (final MapEntry(:key, :value) in map.entries) {
    await save(key, value);
  }
}
// CASE dart_then_chain expect=fire
Future<void> e(List<int> items) {
  Future<void> chain = Future.value();
  for (final item in items) {
    chain = chain.then((_) => save(item));
  }
  return chain;
}
// CASE dart_await_variable expect=fire
Future<void> f(List<int> items) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    final pending = save(item);
    await pending;
  }
}
// CASE dart_while_remove_last expect=fire
Future<void> g(List<int> items) async {
  final queue = [...items];
  while (queue.isNotEmpty) {
    await save(queue.removeLast());
  }
}
// CASE end expect=pass
